items.stem: Choose the particle that best completes: 「日本語＿勉強しています。」 (I am studying Japanese.)

options.rationale: Correct: を marks the direct object (Japanese) of the verb 勉強する.
が marks a subject, not the object being studied here.
に marks a destination or time, not this object.
で marks a location or means, not the object.

items.explanation: を marks the direct object of 勉強する.

items.stem: What is the most common reading of the kanji 経済 (economy)?

options.rationale: Correct: 経済 is read けいざい.
済 is read ざい here, not さい.
経 is read けい, not きょう, in this word.
That is a different word (形勢/形成), not 経済.

items.explanation: 経済 is read けいざい.

items.stem: To improve timed JLPT N2 listening, select TWO practices that most directly help.

options.text: Practise with audio at natural native speed
options.rationale: Correct: training at native speed builds the needed processing speed.

options.text: Learn to grasp the main point without decoding every word
options.rationale: Correct: gist comprehension prevents stalling on unknown words.

options.text: Pause after every sentence to translate to English
options.rationale: Translating each sentence is too slow for timed listening.

options.text: Only study written transcripts, never audio
options.rationale: Reading alone does not train listening.

options.text: Memorise the answer options before hearing the audio
options.rationale: Options are not known in advance and cannot be pre-memorised.

items.explanation: Native-speed practice and gist comprehension most directly improve timed listening.
